data.name: Clickstream Data for Online Shopping
data.abstract: The dataset contains information on clickstream from online store offering clothing for pregnant women.

intro_paper.title: Discovering Patterns of Users' Behaviour in an E-shop - Comparison of Consumer Buying Behaviours in Poland and Other European Countries

variables.name: order
variables.description: sequence of clicks during one session

variables.name: country
variables.description: variable indicating the country of origin of the IP address

variables.name: page 2 (clothing model)
variables.description: contains information about the code for each product (217 products)

variables.name: location
variables.description: photo location on the page, the screen has been divided into six parts

variables.name: price 2
variables.description: variable informing whether the price of a particular product is higher than the average price for the entire product category

variables.name: page
variables.description: page number within the e-store website (from 1 to 5)

additional_info.summary: The dataset contains information on clickstream from online store offering clothing for pregnant women. Data are from five months of 2008 and include, among others, product category, location of the photo on the page, country of origin of the IP address and product price in US dollars.
additional_info.variable_info: The dataset contains 14 variables described in a separate file (See 'Data set description')
